hints.title: Operator Precedence and Two Accumulators
hints.text: Maintain an operand collection of tree nodes and an operator buffer for tokens.

hints.title: Precedence Invariant
hints.text: Multiplication and division have higher precedence than addition and subtraction.

hints.title: Tree Construction Reductions
hints.text: When popping an operator op, pop right node and left node, create Node(op, left, right), and push it to the node stack.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of infix expression string s
complexity.notes: Each character is pushed and popped from operator and node stacks at most once in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full syntax tree backtracking causes exponential re-parsing of parenthesized sub-expressions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual-stack Shunting-Yard parser processes infix grammar in a single left-to-right pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Classic Shunting-Yard operator precedence parsing building binary nodes.

solutions.approach: JavaScript Shunting-Yard Dual Stack Tree Builder
